title.narrative: Strengthening Disaster Risk Reduction and Resilience in Pacific SIDS through Sci

description.narrative: UNESCO DRR Programme in collaboration with Pacific Office aims to enhance disaster risk reduction (DRR) capacities and strengthen resilience across Pacific Small Island Developing States (SIDS) through science-based approaches, improved early warning systems, and strengthened regional cooperation. It addresses multi-hazard risks by improving geohazard monitoring, data systems, and technical capacity, while supporting national policies, standard operating procedures, and community preparedness. Building on UNESCO’s existing programmes, it promotes end-to-end early warning and risk-informed decision-making. The project also fosters regional collaboration and knowledge sharing, including the development of a regional geohazard strategy and coordination mechanisms. By integrating science into policy and practice, it enhances preparedness, response capacity, and long-term resilience across the Pacific.
